content.content:
You travel to Ashgate Landing.

You are Wanderer, at Ashgate Landing.

Doors: Door to Barge Hold (open) (quest marker)
Dralin Uveran walks up to you and speaks.
Dralin Uveran: Dralin Uveran, a step from the hold's door as the player comes out. Tells: he is Dralin Uveran, gang-master here. The player's name is not on his roll: he struck it this morning, before they cut a single reed, on an order brought down the road by Vosh-Leera, the root-herald of Jal-Veesa, the one who speaks for that town's elders and its tree to outsiders. He cannot refuse a root-herald. "You must have friends in high places." He paid for the player's months and has lost them. Vosh-Leera left word: she will have work for the player if they bring her some Sithis' beard, a grey moss that hangs on the woven weir at Reed-Sill Weir, the weir-wardens' camp where the road east meets the creek; her house is in Jal-Veesa, a little further on past the weir. What she wants with either of them he does not know and does not care to. Mind the crocodiles under the weir. Then: the player will need to look after themselves on the road. He has not got much to spare, but he can offer one of these, things dead cutters left behind when the fever took them: a Naga warhammer, flint set in a wooden head; a Naga sword, a wooden blade edged with flint; a bamboo bow with twenty flint-tipped arrows and a flint knife; or a spell tome of Sparks that one of them carried up from Stormhold, which teaches a lightning spell. Take your pick. Does: sets stage 50. Checks: nothing.

*** Journal updated: No Name on the Work Roll ***
Journal: Dralin Uveran, the Dunmer gang-master of Ashgate Landing, met me on the landing. He struck my name from his roll this morning, on an order brought by Vosh-Leera, the root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. He does not know why she wants me, and he is sour about it. He says she will have work for me if I bring her some Sithis' beard, a grey moss that hangs on the woven weir at Reed-Sill Weir, east up the road. Before I go, he offered me one thing from what dead cutters left behind: a Naga warhammer, a Naga sword, a bamboo bow with arrows and a flint knife, or a spell tome of Sparks. I should take my pick, or tell him I will manage without.

content.text:
The quest "No Name on the Work Roll" is complete, and the game has accepted my final notes.

- **How it started:** I woke in the hold of a work barge at Ashgate Landing, Black Marsh. Okeeh, the gang's cook, told me I was serving the Owing, which is months of owed work cutting reed. I told her I was a hunter, and the hold door was unbarred.
- **What changed:** Dralin Uveran, the gang-master, said he had struck my name from his roll that morning. He did it on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. He doesn't know why she wanted that.
- **Gear:** I chose the bamboo bow, 20 flint arrows and a flint knife. I also have 2 lockpicks and 0 gold.
- **Next:** Vosh-Leera will have work for me if I bring her Sithis' beard, a grey moss that hangs on the weir at Reed-Sill Weir. Dralin warned of crocodiles under it. Her house is in Jal-Veesa, a little past the weir.
- **Still unknown:** I don't know why Vosh-Leera wants me, what a Hist is, or what Jal-Veesa's tree is. I never asked Okeeh or Dralin about those.
